scope.body: Applies to pronuxfin.com and PRONUXFIN-operated subdomains, including authenticated areas (dashboard, simulated portfolio, alerts, and tools).

usage.title: Purposes
usage.body: Authenticate, operate the desk, personalize experience, meet legal obligations, and improve reliability. We do not use your data for personalized investment recommendations.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: Infrastructure providers (hosting, database, transactional email) and market APIs receive only what is needed to deliver the service. We do not share portfolio or watchlist data with advertisers.

rights.title: Your rights

bullPoints: Liquidity abundant with inflation drifting to target — lifts risk valuations.
Long-end curve pricing cuts — tighter Brazil risk premia.
Earnings revisions up on blue chips and net foreign flows into Brazilian equities.
Crypto risk-on regime with BTC dominance flat/falling — room for liquid alt-beta.
Structural commodities (transition energy / metals) supporting exports & FX.
bearPoints: Restrictive monetary policy lasts longer — cost of capital higher than priced.
Inverted curves + widening credit spreads — caution for cycle & earnings.
Geopolitical or logistic shocks tightening core inflation.
Fiscal risk pushing country premia higher — equities & FX hedge pressure.
Crypto liquidity withdrawn, BTC/Nasdaq correlation high amid broad sells — beware leverage.

AssetTerminal.statementsDisclaimer: Figures reflect what the company reported to the data vendor. Filing lag, restatements and FX effects can change the picture. PRONUXFIN does not audit these numbers and does not provide investment advice.
AssetTerminal.termsSubtitle: What the company does, sector framing, market peers and reads derived from the price curve — not a substitute for financial statements or regulatory filings.
AssetTerminal.termsPeersDisclaimer: Tickers often correlated or in the same sector per the data feed. They are not subsidiaries, affiliates or corporate group members.
AssetTerminal.termsPeersEmpty: No peer list returned for this symbol from the external feed.
AssetTerminal.termsSubsidiariesNote: Branches, subsidiaries and full corporate group structure usually require regulatory filings (SEC, CVM, etc.) or premium databases. Here we only show what the public feed returns reliably.
